message.content:
Emerald green silk blend sheath dress, A-line cut, midi length reaching just below the knee, forest green color (#0a3d2e), heavy crepe fabric to provide warmth against the frost.
Charcoal grey tailored wool blazer, structured fit with notched lapels, hip length hitting the mid-thigh, deep charcoal color (#36454f), fine worsted wool fabric for a polished look.
Classic black patent leather pumps, pointed toe silhouette, ankle height, jet black color (#000000), smooth synthetic leather material.
Diamond crystal drop earrings, teardrop shape, medium length reaching the collarbone, clear to icy blue gradient color (#eefcfd), rhinestone crystals on a silver-tone metal setting.
This outfit balances the frosty autumn weather with the upscale restaurant setting by layering a warm wool blazer over a structured silk dress that maintains an elegant silhouette. The rich emerald green of the dress complements her warm skin tones while offering a festive yet sophisticated color suitable for a New Year's celebration. Adding classic black pumps and sparkling crystal earrings elevates the ensemble to meet the formal and smart dress codes without appearing overly stiff.
